SPRINT 3 — InkOS Analytics: KPI Cleanup + Real Deltas + Chart Polish. Project: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS

Sprints 1+2 COMPLETE. Plan: /Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/anaystics-page-lets-deep-fizzy-turtle.md

## What Sprints 1+2 already shipped
- Foundation: range/compare/CSV/toolbar wired across all 6 tabs
- Heatmap CSS fixed (color-mix oklch)
- BookingsHeatmap component (hours 10–22, Stone→Onyx→Rust ramp)
- StatusBreakdownBar (all 7 statuses reconcile to total)
- Bookings 6→3 KPI cards
- Low stock single-source unified
- All API routes return `{ current, prior? }` shape
- All clients read URL params + key React Query

## Sprint 3 Goal
Cut 2 redundant elements. Consolidate KPI grids on Revenue + Clients tabs. Light up REAL compare deltas + dashed prior-period overlays across every chart. Make compare mode visibly meaningful.

## Constraints (mandatory load)
- /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/CLAUDE.md sections 4 (Brand), 5 (UI), 7 (Architecture), 8 (Forbidden), 9 (Antipatterns)
- Brand: ONLY Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust. Tabular-nums. Custom shadow tokens only.
- No `any`, no `@ts-ignore`, no `console.log`
- KpiCard already supports `delta`, `trend`, `invertTrend`, `subtextLabel`, `sparkline`, `accentVar` — REUSE, don't rebuild
- Existing format utils: `formatCurrency`, `formatPercent` (added Sprint 1), `formatDate` from `lib/utils.ts`
- CountUp animation in KpiCard — verify it doesn't fight with delta render on toggle

## Tasks (execute in order)

### 1. Revenue tab — 5→4 KPI cards + cut redundant bar chart + auto-scale + "Closed" tooltip
File: `components/reports/RevenueReportClient.tsx`

- Drop standalone **Tips** KPI card. Surface tips inside Revenue card via `subtextLabel` like `"$2,730 in tips included"` or as `sparkline`. Match audit example: `"$20,600 \\n $2,730 in tips included"`.
- Result: 4 cards — Revenue, Sessions, Avg Session, Deposits Collected.
- **Cut the Revenue-by-Period bar chart** (the redundant one). Replace with a line/bar mode toggle on the existing Revenue-over-time chart. Use shadcn `ToggleGroup` or 2 `Button` group: `Line | Bar`. Mode default: line.
- **Auto-scale Y axis** on the line chart. Currently fixed `$0–$2000`. Recharts auto-scales by default — verify domain prop isn't hardcoded.
- **Tooltip "Closed" label** when value=0 on a known closed day. Studio operating hours config likely lives somewhere in `studio_settings` table — but minimum viable v1: if `value === 0`, display `"Closed"` instead of `"$0"` in the tooltip. Note in code comment that future enhancement is to check studio's actual closed days.

### 2. Update `RechartsAreaChart` + `RechartsBarChart` — share API, add priorSeries support
Files: `components/reports/RechartsAreaChart.tsx`, `components/reports/RechartsBarChart.tsx`

Both accept new optional props:
```ts
priorData?: Array<{ name: string; value: number }>  // dashed prior-period series
priorLabel?: string  // e.g., "Prior Last month ($18,400)"
```

Render: dashed line in Stone color overlaid on top of current series. Stone strokeDasharray="4 4". Tooltip should show both current and prior values when prior is provided.

Optional: extract a tiny `mode: 'line' | 'bar'` switch into a shared `RevenueTrendChart` wrapper component that delegates to area or bar based on mode prop. If easier, just use both components and conditionally render in the client.

### 3. Compare-aware deltas — all KPIs everywhere
Every `*ReportClient.tsx` that consumes `{ current, prior? }`:
- When `prior` exists, compute delta per KPI: `((current - prior) / prior) * 100` clamped to safe values (handle div-by-zero → null)
- Pass `delta` to KpiCard with `trend: 'up' | 'down' | 'neutral'` and `invertTrend` for inverse metrics (no-show%, cancellation%, inactive clients) so Rust = bad direction
- Format delta with `formatPercent` and `+`/`−` prefix
- KpiCard's existing `subtextLabel` shows `"vs prior {label}"` when compare on, e.g., `"+12% vs prior month"`

Files to update with deltas:
- `RevenueReportClient.tsx` — Revenue, Sessions, Avg Session, Deposits
- `BookingsReportClient.tsx` — Total, Completion rate, No-show + Cancelled (already 3 cards from Sprint 2)
- `ClientsReportClient.tsx` — see task 4
- `ArtistsReportClient.tsx` — leaderboard already shows ranking; verify if any KPI cards exist on this tab; if so add deltas
- `InventoryReportClient.tsx` — Total items, Low stock, COGS, Stock value (Sprint 5 adds the 4th)
- `AiUsageReportClient.tsx` — Generations, Cost, Tokens, Avg Rating

If APIs from Sprint 1 don't yet emit prior block KPIs at the right granularity, extend each `app/api/reports/*/route.ts` to compute prior KPIs alongside current. The API already runs `Promise.all` for current/prior fetches per Sprint 1 — just ensure the `prior` block contains the same KPI shape as `current.kpis`.

### 4. Clients tab — 6→4 KPI cards, kill identical person-icons
File: `components/reports/ClientsReportClient.tsx`

Replace 6 cards with 4:
- **Total clients** — value=total, delta vs prior
- **New this period** — value=newClients, delta
- **Retention rate** — value=`{rate}%`, delta
- **Avg LTV** — value=`{currency}`, delta

Drop these as standalone cards (surface inside charts in Sprint 5):
- Returning clients
- Inactive 90d

KILL identical person-icons. Either remove icons entirely OR vary per metric (Users, UserPlus, Repeat, DollarSign from lucide-react). Audit prefers removal — go with no icons unless the visual feels too sparse, in which case use varied lucide icons.

### 5. No-show pill — Rust filled when >10%, Stone outlined otherwise
On artist leaderboard rows AND any place no-show% appears as a `Badge`. Use existing `Badge` variants — likely need a custom inline style with brand tokens since shadcn defaults don't map 1:1.

```tsx
<Badge
  className={cn(
    'tabular-nums',
    rate > 10
      ? 'bg-[var(--color-rust)] text-[var(--color-bone)] border-transparent'
      : 'bg-transparent text-[var(--color-stone)] border-[var(--color-stone)]'
  )}
>
  {rate}% no-show
</Badge>
```

Apply in `ArtistsReportClient.tsx` and any `BookingsReportClient.tsx` rendering of no-show rate.

### 6. AI Monthly Cost — empty state when data points < 2
File: `components/reports/AiUsageReportClient.tsx`

When monthly cost timeline has < 2 data points, render `<EmptyState variant="coming-soon" title="Awaiting more data" description="Add another month of usage to see the trend." />` instead of the single-bar chart that looks broken.

### 7. Stock value formatting consistency
File: `components/reports/InventoryReportClient.tsx` + `app/api/reports/inventory/route.ts`

All currency values use `formatCurrency(cents)` with 2 decimals consistently. Eliminate the `$3,409.5` vs `$14,639.86` mix the audit flagged. If `formatCurrency` already produces 2 decimals — verify and audit the call sites in inventory client. If any raw `value.toFixed(1)` exists — replace.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Revenue tab: 4 KPI cards, single chart with line/bar toggle, auto-scale Y, "Closed" tooltip on $0 days
- [ ] Bookings tab: 3 KPI cards (already from Sprint 2) now show real deltas with compare on
- [ ] Clients tab: 4 KPI cards, no identical person-icons, deltas visible with compare
- [ ] Compare on/off → dashed prior line appears/disappears on every chart
- [ ] No-show pill Rust filled on artists ≥10%, Stone outline otherwise
- [ ] AI Monthly Cost: empty state until 2+ months of data
- [ ] All currency formatted `$X,XXX.XX` consistently — no `$3,409.5`
- [ ] Compare deltas use `formatPercent` with `+`/`−` prefix
- [ ] Inverse metrics (no-show%, cancellation%) flip color logic — Rust = bad direction
- [ ] Mobile 375px: every tab still no horizontal overflow

## Validation gates (mandatory)
```bash
pnpm typecheck
pnpm lint
pnpm test
```
Skip `pnpm build` — known pre-existing failures from `@anthropic-ai/sdk` are out-of-scope.

Fix every error in YOUR new/modified files. Pre-existing errors elsewhere are not your scope.

## Report format (caveman OK)
1. Files created
2. Files modified
3. Decisions (e.g., line/bar toggle UX, icon strategy on Clients)
4. Validation gate results
5. Follow-ups for Sprint 4 (artist drill-down)
